narrative: 大多数对话场景想要的就是这个视野范围。你能看到倾听者的肩膀、一盏灯、一片墙面，还有一张不会变形膨胀的脸。
这支镜头会做一点“编辑”性质的工作（比50mm展示更多的地方），但不会像24mm和14mm那样把房间变成一个角色。当场地必须占据主导地位，或者人物必须成为唯一的风景时，这不是合适的工具。
街头主镜头和厨房双人镜头通常更适合用24mm；孤立感的特写则更适合用85mm。
如果你把每一个景别都用35mm拍，覆盖镜头会很匹配，但你永远不会改变空间给人的感觉。
how: 站在对话时的常见距离，大致相当于隔着桌子或在一个小房间里说话的距离。在Super 35画幅上，35mm接近该画幅的“标准”焦距；在全画幅上，它则是一个温和的广角。
无论哪种情况，只要你不把镜头怼到鼻尖前，透视就会保持温和。除非倾斜本身就是要表达的那句话，否则保持垂直线条的真实。
提示词：35mm on [Subject], storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50.
when: 用它来拍大多数应该显得“有人味”、而不是长焦感的叙事性覆盖镜头：桌边的双人镜头、穿过门口的一段行走。如果一部影片需要空间感发生变化来传递意义，不要把它当作唯一的焦段。
vs: 24mm广角展示更多的建筑信息，拉伸也更多；50mm标准镜头则向对话本身裁近，“编辑”的痕迹更少。
85mm人像镜头从更远的地方拍摄，孤立出这张脸，并压缩堆叠背景；35mm则是中间地带的“叙事者”焦段，而不是一种风格。
examples_film: 《月光男孩》（Moonlight）常常用一种适中的中广角来拍室内的脸，让迈阿密始终在场，却不会变成一张明信片。《海边的曼彻斯特》（Manchester by the Sea）在新英格兰的室内空间里做着同样的事：人物身处地方之中，既不被压缩，也不被拉伸。
这是默认覆盖方式的语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是50mm标准镜头（房间信息太少）或24mm广角（拉伸太多）。破绽要么是一个紧凑的对话式裁切，墙面被虚化融掉，要么是一个报道式的广角，家具显得逼近而突兀。
解决办法：站在对话的距离上，脸加上一片真实的场地信息，保持温和的透视。

faq.q: What is 35mm moderate wide in film?
faq.a: 这是常见的叙事性中广角焦段：比50mm展示更多一点的世界，但没有24mm那么多的拉伸。脸保持人味，房间保持可读。
在同一站位上，35mm能容纳更多房间信息；50mm更紧凑，更不愿意展示场地。35mm是默认的叙事覆盖，50mm则是拒绝“发表意见”的镜头。

faq.q: When should I use 35mm moderate wide?
faq.a: 用它来拍大多数需要脸和房间同时在场的对话与覆盖镜头。当场地应该占据主导地位，或者脸应该成为整个国度时，跳过它。

faq.q: How do I prompt 35mm moderate wide for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：35mm on [Subject], storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50。点名房间里的一部分信息。禁止14mm式的畸变和85mm式的孤立感。

narrative: Most talking scenes want this field. You see the listener's shoulder, a lamp, a slice of wall, and a face that does not balloon.

The glass does a little editorial work (more place than a 50) without turning the room into a character the way 24mm and 14mm do. It is the wrong tool when the location must dominate, or when the person must become the only landscape.
Street masters and kitchen two-shots often belong at 24mm. Isolation close-ups belong at 85mm.
If you shoot every size on 35mm, the coverage matches, but you never change how space feels.
how: Stand at a conversational distance, roughly the same as a person talking across a table or a small room. On Super 35, 35mm sits near format-normal; on full frame it is a mild wide.
Either way the perspective is gentle if you do not crowd the nose. Keep verticals honest unless a tilt is the sentence.
Prompt: 35mm on [Subject], storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50.
when: Use it for most narrative coverage that should feel human but not telephoto: a two-shot at a table, a walk through a doorway. Do not use it as the only length in a film that needs space to change meaning.
vs: 24mm Wide shows more architecture and more stretch. 50mm Normal crops toward the conversation and editorialize less.
85mm Portrait from farther back isolates the face and stacks the background. 35mm is the middle storyteller, not a look.
examples_film: Moonlight often covers faces in rooms at a moderate wide-normal so Miami stays present without becoming a postcard. Manchester by the Sea does the same with New England interiors: people in places, neither squeezed nor stretched.
Grammar for default coverage, not a frame to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is 50mm Normal (too little room) or 24mm Wide (too much stretch). The tell is either a tight conversational crop with a melted wall, or a reportage wide with looming furniture.
Fix: conversational stand, face plus a true slice of place, mild perspective.

faq.q: What is 35mm moderate wide in film?
faq.a: It is the common narrative wide-normal: a little more world than a 50mm, without the stretch of a 24mm. Faces stay human and rooms stay readable.
35mm includes more of the room from the same stand. 50mm is tighter and less willing to show place. 35mm is default story coverage. 50mm is the glass that refuses to editorialize.

faq.q: When should I use 35mm moderate wide?
faq.a: Use it for most talk and coverage that needs face and room together. Skip it when the location should dominate or when the face should be the whole country.

faq.q: How do I prompt 35mm moderate wide for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: 35mm on [Subject], storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50. Name a slice of the room. Forbid 14mm distortion and 85mm isolation.
